pages.title: Topological Phase Transmuter
pages.text: The $(item)Topological Phase Transmuter$() changes a material's topology without changing its chemistry.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.

Topology is about what survives smooth deformation: a mug and a doughnut are the same shape, one hole each. In topological materials the same atoms can sit in phases that differ only in such global properties. Thouless, Haldane and Kosterlitz shared the 2016 Nobel for it.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (5 item and 2 fluid inputs, 2 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Calabi-Yau Manifold, Higgs Field Capacitor, Topological Circuit Board, Topological Insulator.
